entries.name: Cable Pull-Through
entries.reason: Redrawn on 8 October 2026 at the owner's request, because the earlier drawing contradicted this text: it showed the cable running to a pulley in front of the athlete. Source-bound side-view draft: facing away from a low pulley with the rope held at the hips and the cable running back between the legs; the hips go back and the flat back hinges forward over soft knees with the feet planted, then the hips drive forward to stand tall. The cable is drawn behind the near leg and only lengthens as the athlete stands.
entries.summary: Facing away from a low cable with the rope between your legs, push the hips back and hinge with a flat back, then drive the hips forward to stand tall.

frames.caption: Face away from a low cable with a rope between your legs, held at your hips, and walk out until the cable is taut.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Push the hips back: the arms just hold the rope.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at lockout.

entries.name: Band Good Morning (Pull Through)
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, from the description accepted that day: the earlier drawing showed a cable pull-through: the load between the legs from behind, and no band at the neck. Source-bound side-view draft: facing a post with a band looped round its base and over the back of the neck, held at the collar with both hands; the hips go back and the flat trunk folds to near level against the band, then the hips drive forward to stand tall. The knees keep one soft bend for the whole rep, the leg turning about the ankle as one piece. The band only lengthens as the athlete stands. Not drawn: the shoulder-width stance, which a side view cannot show, and the loop behind the neck.
entries.summary: Facing a post with a band from its base over the back of your neck, push the hips back and fold a flat back to near level, then drive the hips forward to stand tall.

frames.caption: Loop a band around the base of a post, face the post and put the other end over your head so it rests low on the back of your neck, holding it there with both hands.
With the knees slightly bent and the back flat, push the hips back and fold forward until the torso is near level with the floor or the back starts to round.
Band behind the neck, never across the throat.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall again.
Hips back, back flat.

entries.name: Hip Extension with Bands
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, from the description accepted that day: the earlier drawing showed a two-legged pull-through hinge, which is a different movement. Source-bound side-view draft: standing tall facing a post and holding it, a band from low on the post to the near ankle; that leg goes straight back with the knee straight while the trunk and the standing leg do not move, then returns more slowly. The band only lengthens as the leg goes back. One leg is shown; the last caption carries the change of legs.
entries.summary: Standing tall and holding a post, with a band from the post to one ankle, take that leg straight back with the knee straight and the trunk still, then return it slowly and change legs.

frames.caption: Fix one end of a band low on a post and the other around one ankle, then face the post, hold it for balance and step back until the band is just taut.
Standing tall with the chest up and the banded knee straight, squeeze the glute to take that leg straight back as far as it goes without the lower back arching.
Stop before the lower back arches.
Return the leg slowly to the start.
Complete the repetitions, then change legs.

entries.name: Nordic Curl
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft: kneeling on a soft floor pad with the ankles secured beneath an immovable floor anchor, holding one straight line from knees to head with the hips extended, lowering that line slowly until the hands catch the floor, and pulling back up with the hamstrings.
entries.summary: Kneeling on a soft pad with the ankles secured beneath an anchor, hold one line from knees to head and lower as slowly as possible, catch with the hands, and pull back up with the hamstrings.

frames.caption: Kneel on a soft pad with the ankles secured beneath an immovable anchor, holding one line from knees to head with the hips extended.
Lower that straight line from the knees as slowly as possible.
Catch with the hands.
Pull back up with the hamstrings, using only as much push from the hands as needed.
One line from knees to head, lower as slowly as you can, keep the hips extended, and use only the hand push you need.

entries.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft: kneeling tall on the elevated knee pad of a Nordic bench with the ankles locked under the foot rollers, lowering forward in one knee-to-shoulder line to a deeper knee extension until the hands lightly catch the floor below the bench, and curling back up with the hamstrings.
entries.summary: Kneeling tall in a Nordic bench with the ankles locked under the foot pads, lower forward in one straight line by extending at the knees, catch lightly on the floor, and curl back up with the hamstrings.

frames.caption: Kneel tall in a Nordic bench with the ankles locked under the foot pads, hips and shoulders in one line.
Lower yourself forward by extending at the knees, keeping the hips straight rather than folding.
Catch yourself lightly with the hands on the floor at the bottom.
Curl the body back up by pulling with the hamstrings, using only as much push from the hands as needed.
Keep the hips extended in line with the torso, control the lowering phase, and use the hands only to assist the transition.

entries.name: Natural Glute Ham Raise
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft: kneeling in a Nordic bench with the ankles locked under the foot pads and a band anchored behind to assist the return, lowering in one straight knee-to-shoulder line until the knees are almost straight without touching the floor, and pulling back to upright with the band assisting the reversal.
entries.summary: Set up in a Nordic bench with the ankles locked under the foot pads and a band anchored behind to assist, lower in one straight line until the knees are almost straight, then pull yourself back to upright with the band assisting the reversal.

frames.caption: Set up in a Nordic bench with the ankles locked under the foot pads and a band anchored behind to assist the return, starting upright with good posture.
Lower yourself under control until the knees are almost straight.
Hold the straight knee-to-shoulder line against the band tension at the bottom.
Reverse the movement and pull yourself back to upright, letting the band assist only as much as you need.
Keep the hips in line with the shoulders, lower as slowly as you control, and let the band assist the reversal.
